title: Render truthful project books and native task hierarchy in the overlay
acceptance_criteria: Ideas, Tasks and Project library use shared GitHub projections with qualified identities and at most three record cards per page
Native milestone stages and parent/subissue hierarchy remain distinct, cycle-safe and complete for loaded data; unknown relationships stay visible
Explicit repository library declarations retain immutable Markdown versions and declared states without implying verified task acceptance
Progressive bounded private-helper frames render known data before expensive unchanged acceptance proof; stale, partial and pending verification remain explicit
Restricted native messages/source allowlist preserve private configuration, CSP, transparency, activity and room/monitor invariants
Real Edge keyboard/DOM and native Windows composition-host UI evidence plus existing full suites establish actual behavior
Independent stage/exact-head-base PR and exact-main postmerge acceptance precede publisher-driven Issue23 closure
